deterministic.proposal:
PROCEDURE close_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
FOR $v2 IN $v0 : SET_STATUS $v2 CLOSED
RETURN $v1
END
